title: Imitation Learning for Connection-Tableau Construction
abstract: arXiv:2608.26009v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An automated theorem prover builds a proof step by step, choosing at each point what to add and what to remove. We cast this construction as a policy acting in a transition system induced by a formal calculus, which fixes which steps are sound: for clausal connection tableaux, leanCoP-style search and plCoP/rlCoP-style planning then become stateful policies over one interface, and policy-learning methods apply directly. We equip such policies with a graph neural network that scores proof edits from structure that transfers across problems, train it by imitation learning from found proofs, and measure how performance holds as we remove search scaffolding, from full symbolic backtracking to a policy the network drives alone. Within a fixed step budget on M2k, MPTP2078-bushy, and TPTP v9.2.1, learned policies solve up to 46% more problems than leanCoP, and reach proofs in an order of magnitude fewer steps.

translated_title: 基于模仿学习的连接表构建
translated_abstract: 自动定理证明器逐步构建证明，每一步选择添加或删除什么内容。我们将此构建过程视为在形式演算诱导的转移系统中运行的策略，该演算确保步骤的合理性：对于子句连接表，leanCoP风格的搜索和plCoP/rlCoP风格的规划成为统一接口上的有状态策略，策略学习方法可直接应用。我们为这些策略配备图神经网络，该网络根据跨问题迁移的结构对证明编辑进行评分，通过从找到的证明中进行模仿学习来训练，并测量当移除搜索支架（从完全符号回溯到网络单独驱动的策略）时性能如何保持。在M2k、MPTP2078-bushy和TPTP v9.2.1上的固定步骤预算内，学习策略比leanCoP多解决高达46%的问题，并以数量级更少的步骤达到证明。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于模仿学习和图神经网络的策略方法，用于连接表构建，在固定步骤预算下比传统搜索方法解决更多问题且步骤数大幅减少。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an imitation learning and graph neural network-based policy for connection-tableau construction, solving up to 46% more problems than leanCoP within fixed step budgets and reaching proofs in an order of magnitude fewer steps.
